subject.title: clawhub install does not register skill hooks automatically

question: Should installing a ClawHub skill ever activate bundled OpenClaw hooks automatically, and if so what manifest validation, scan result, consent, lifecycle, and uninstall contract is required?
rationale: The current products deliberately separate passive skill extraction from hook-pack installation; choosing to collapse that boundary changes when third-party executable code becomes enabled and cannot be resolved safely from source behavior alone.

options.title: Keep hook activation explicit
options.body: Keep skills inert on `clawhub install` and add a clear detected-hook handoff that requires the user to invoke the supported plugin installation flow after inspection.

options.title: Design an approved activation contract
options.body: Specify a signed or validated hook-pack manifest, scan/permission display, explicit consent, rollback, update, and uninstall behavior before enabling automatic registration.

options.title: Continue manual-only behavior
options.body: Retain the present separation and document that hook-capable packages must be installed through OpenClaw's plugin surface.

recommendation.title: Keep hook activation explicit
recommendation.body: Keep skills inert on `clawhub install` and add a clear detected-hook handoff that requires the user to invoke the supported plugin installation flow after inspection.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the OpenClaw plugin installer and ClawHub's skill-install contract.
